Results matter, but so do the people on the other side of every screen.

I'm a developer turned designer who has spent 8+ years inside healthcare, federal, and enterprise systems, the kind where a confusing flow isn't just friction, it's risk. My edge is the rare mix: I think in systems, I can speak engineering, and I design for accessibility and trust from day one.

Away from the screen, I'm into martial arts, dance, comics, and travel, and I once grew a comics YouTube channel to millions of views using the same research instincts I bring to product.
